title: Depression edge
description: Terrain around this reviewed depression has about 7.2 m of local relief relative to the mean of four samples 64 m from its center. Crater origin and rim depth are uncertain.
risks: A descent can increase the effort needed to return. Edges may conceal a change in footing.
precautions: Inspect the contour and return profile, and consider routing around the depression.

title: Loose-sand scenario
description: Illustrative loose-material zone positioned in the orbital texture context. Surface bearing strength has not been measured here.
risks: Loose material could reduce traction and increase walking effort.
precautions: Assess the local surface and consider a firmer alternative in this scenario.

title: Scarp exposure scenario
description: Illustrative exposure area near terrain relief. The archive does not provide a rockfall forecast.
risks: Material falling from higher terrain could affect an exposed traverse.
precautions: Review a wider stand-off route and inspect the slope context.
communicationsNote: Nearby relief may obstruct the habitat view. Review relay visibility; radio coverage has not been calculated.

title: Dust-storm scenario
description: A user-enabled visibility scenario affecting this entire demonstration sector.
risks: Reduced visibility could obscure landmarks and delay progress.
precautions: Review the habitat return route and pause the scenario if visibility assumptions are unsuitable.
